profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Full-Stack Software Engineer with 4+ years of design and development experience delivering web-based applications to scale. Out of the box thinking and ability to learn and leverage new technologies within a development lifecycle.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Build and integrate systems used to support digital gameplay for internal and external partners.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Participate in all aspects of agile software development including design, implementation, and deployment
- Design and development, testing, and integration of multiple REST APIs using GoLang and PostgreSQL
- Prototype, develop, test and integrate best-in-class responsive Angular components
- Work primarily in GoLang, PostgreSQL, Typescript, Angular, HTML, and CSS
- Collaborate across time zones via Slack, GitHub comments, documents, and frequent video conferences
- Assign, track, and manage work via Jira ticketing system

positions.title: System Engineer
positions.description:
- Assist in developing code in the form of pinball rules
- Perform functional and design verification tests
- Other programming tasks with skillset to effectuate graphic or lower level design
- Diagnose and troubleshoot problems within an electrical system and propose improvements
- Aid in documentation and wiring of systems
- Maintains knowledge of current technology
- Other duties as needed and assigned

positions.title: Web Developer Internship
positions.description: Interning for the Web Development team of Whataburger to assist in the development of the company's web applications and earn valuable knowledge / experience working in a corporate IT position.
